title: Silent and Costly: Characterizing and Detecting Prompt-Caching Mis-Integration in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34817v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) services process massive volumes of user requests, resulting in substantial inference costs. To reduce both cost and latency, providers have introduced prompt caching. However, correctly integrating prompt caching is non-trivial due to heterogeneous provider-specific APIs and continuously evolving caching semantics. To understand prompt-caching mis-integration in downstream applications, we conduct the first empirical study of 120 prompt-caching-related pull requests from 10 popular open-source agent systems. Our findings show that prompt-caching mis-integrations arise in both request-side misconfiguration and read-side usage miscount. More importantly, most mis-integrations fail silently without causing observable runtime failures.   Motivated by these findings, we design CACHELINT, which models a prompt-caching mis-integration as an invocation site together with the preconditions required for correct cache

translated_title: 静默而代价高昂：LLM智能体中提示缓存错误集成的问题表征与检测
translated_abstract: 大规模语言模型服务需要处理海量的用户请求，从而产生巨额的推理成本。为了同时降低成本与延迟，服务提供商引入了提示缓存技术。然而，由于各提供商的API存在异构性且缓存语义持续演变，正确集成提示缓存并非易事。为了理解下游应用中提示缓存的错误集成问题，我们对来自10个流行开源智能体系统的120个与提示缓存相关的拉取请求开展了首次实证研究。研究结果表明，提示缓存错误集成既源于请求侧的错误配置，也源于读取侧的使用计数错误。更重要的是，大多数错误集成会静默失败，不会引发任何可观察到的运行时故障。基于这些发现，我们设计了CACHELINT，它将提示缓存错误集成建模为一个调用点以及正确缓存所需的先决条件
tldr: 该论文首次对10个开源智能体系统中120个提示缓存相关的拉取请求进行实证研究，揭示了提示缓存错误集成往往静默失败且难以察觉的问题，并据此提出了检测工具CACHELINT。
en_tdlr: Through the first empirical study of 120 prompt-caching-related pull requests across 10 open-source agent systems, this paper reveals that prompt-caching mis-integrations often fail silently, and proposes CACHELINT to detect them.
